title: Circuit Block
description: A pre-defined template representing a common passive crossover filter topology, parsed from a .xsc file. Contains component definitions, parametric variable declarations, value formulas, and wiring information.

title.description: Display name of the circuit block (line 1 of .xsc file)

identifier.description: Unique identifier derived from the source filename (without extension)

variables.description: Exactly 6 variable slots. Unused slots have empty name and description with defaultValue of 0.

components.description: Passive component definitions with formulas for parametric value calculation

grounds.description: Ground connection positions relative to the block origin

wires.description: Wire segments connecting components within the block

texts.description: Text annotations for labeling the block layout

name.description: Variable name (may be empty for unused slots)

description.description: Human-readable description of the variable (may be empty)

defaultValue.description: Default numeric value for the variable

variable.description: A parametric variable slot. The .xsc format always has 6 slots; unused slots have empty name and description.

defaultValue.description: Default component value (ohms, farads, or henries depending on partType)

rating.description: Power or voltage rating of the component

position.description: Relative grid position within the block layout

formula.description: Parametric formula string for calculating component value from variables

formulaScale.description: Scale factor applied after formula evaluation

component.description: A passive component definition within the circuit block

gridPosition.description: A position on the schematic grid

start.description: Starting point of the wire segment

end.description: Ending point of the wire segment

wire.description: A wire segment connecting two grid positions

position.description: Position of the text annotation on the grid

size.description: Font size for the text annotation

color.description: Color value for the text annotation (integer representation)

text.description: A text annotation displayed on the schematic
